metadata.host: Apple M6 (M6.local), 12 cores, macOS 27.0.1, otherwise idle, run under caffeinate -dimsu
metadata.gd_release: CMake preset release: CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release (-O3 -DNDEBUG); GD is a static library, no link-time optimization
metadata.gd_release_flto: Same, plus CMAKE_C_FLAGS=-flto, CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-flto and CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS=-flto, so GD, Google Benchmark and the benchmark are all compiled for full LTO
metadata.rustc: rustc 1.99.1 (58cf8f9c3 2026-10-13); repository release profile (thin LTO, one codegen unit), default features, no target-cpu flag
metadata.order: Two rounds; each runs GD release, GD release -flto, then gd-rs
metadata.codegen: Disassembly of the -flto executable: cell_get is inlined in every variant and the Sum05 timed loop contains no calls (scalar, no vector instructions); Sum04 and SumSpecial still call table_column_buffer::cell_set once per row. In the release build cell_get is an out-of-line call in every variant.
